sourceTitle: Bringing GPT-Rosalind to academic research labs
originalTitle: Bringing GPT‑Rosalind to academic research labs
author: OpenAI

blocks.text: We’re introducing the Rosalind Academic Plan to help more academic scientists access GPT‑Rosalind, our dedicated life sciences model, which combines frontier reasoning with Rosalind workbench that enables specialized tool orchestration across medicinal chemistry, genomics, wet-lab assistance, and other scientific applications. Eligible labs can receive up to 30 Business Standard seats at no cost for up to 12 months, with access to GPT‑Rosalind subject to trusted-access approval.
blocks.en: We’re introducing the Rosalind Academic Plan to help more academic scientists access GPT‑Rosalind, our dedicated life sciences model, which combines frontier reasoning with Rosalind workbench that enables specialized tool orchestration across medicinal chemistry, genomics, wet-lab assistance, and other scientific applications. Eligible labs can receive up to 30 Business Standard seats at no cost for up to 12 months, with access to GPT‑Rosalind subject to trusted-access approval.
blocks.zh: 我们已正式启动 Rosalind 学术计划，旨在帮助更多学术科研人员使用 GPT‑Rosalind — 我们专为生命科学打造的模型。该模型将前沿推理能力与 Rosalind 工作台相结合，支持在药物化学、基因组学、湿实验辅助及其他科学应用中进行专业工具编排。符合条件的实验室可免费获得最多 30 个 Business Standard 席位，使用期限最长为 12 个月；通过可信使用权限审批后，即可使用 GPT‑Rosalind。

blocks.text: Academic research creates knowledge that entire fields build on. Work that begins with a fundamental question about biology can eventually change how we diagnose disease, develop medicines, or grow food. But those advances depend on scientists having the resources to explore ideas, test them, and share what they learn.
blocks.en: Academic research creates knowledge that entire fields build on. Work that begins with a fundamental question about biology can eventually change how we diagnose disease, develop medicines, or grow food. But those advances depend on scientists having the resources to explore ideas, test them, and share what they learn.
blocks.zh: 学术研究创造的知识，是整个领域发展的基础。以基础生物学问题为出发点的研究，最终可能会改变我们诊断疾病、开发药物或种植粮食的方式。但要取得这些进展，科学家需要掌握足够的资源，才能探索构想、实践验证，并分享研究所得。

blocks.text: Accelerating scientific discovery is central to OpenAI’s mission of ensuring that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. With this plan, we’re investing in the scientists doing that foundational work—helping more labs combine their expertise and judgment with AI tools built for life sciences research.
blocks.en: Accelerating scientific discovery is central to OpenAI’s mission of ensuring that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. With this plan, we’re investing in the scientists doing that foundational work—helping more labs combine their expertise and judgment with AI tools built for life sciences research.
blocks.zh: OpenAI 的使命是确保通用人工智能惠及全人类，而加速科学发现正是实现这一使命的核心。通过这项计划，我们为从事基础研究的科学家提供支持，帮助更多实验室将其专业知识和判断力与专为生命科学研究打造的 AI 工具相结合。

blocks.text: Supporting the research behind future breakthroughs
blocks.en: Supporting the research behind future breakthroughs
blocks.zh: 助力未来突破性研究

blocks.text: Many of the advances we rely on today grew out of years of basic research.
blocks.en: Many of the advances we rely on today grew out of years of basic research.
blocks.zh: 我们今天受益匪浅的许多成果，都源于多年的基础研究。

blocks.text: The Human Genome Project helped launch modern genomics, transforming medicine, diagnostics, and biotechnology.
blocks.en: The Human Genome Project helped launch modern genomics, transforming medicine, diagnostics, and biotechnology.
blocks.zh: 人类基因组计划推动了现代基因组学的兴起，改变了医学、诊断学和生物技术。

blocks.text: Curiosity-driven work on bacterial immune systems led to CRISPR-Cas9, which revolutionized genome editing and is now advancing research in cancer, inherited disease, agriculture, and biotechnology. Decades of university research on mRNA also laid the groundwork for COVID-19 vaccines and a new generation of vaccines and therapies.
blocks.en: Curiosity-driven work on bacterial immune systems led to CRISPR-Cas9, which revolutionized genome editing and is now advancing research in cancer, inherited disease, agriculture, and biotechnology. Decades of university research on mRNA also laid the groundwork for COVID-19 vaccines and a new generation of vaccines and therapies.
blocks.zh: 由好奇心驱使的细菌免疫系统研究催生了 CRISPR-Cas9，为基因组编辑带来颠覆性变革，如今正推动癌症、遗传病、农业和生物技术领域的研究。高校数十年来对 mRNA 的研究，也为新冠疫苗以及新一代疫苗和疗法奠定了基础。

blocks.text: Academic research has always laid the groundwork for advances in medicine and biotechnology. By helping more scientists combine their scientific expertise and judgment with the advanced specialized reasoning of GPT‑Rosalind, we hope to support discoveries whose benefits reach far beyond the lab.
blocks.en: Academic research has always laid the groundwork for advances in medicine and biotechnology. By helping more scientists combine their scientific expertise and judgment with the advanced specialized reasoning of GPT‑Rosalind, we hope to support discoveries whose benefits reach far beyond the lab.
blocks.zh: 学术研究始终是医学和生物技术进步的基石。我们希望帮助更多科学家将专业知识和判断力与 GPT‑Rosalind 先进的专业推理能力相结合，助其取得突破性发现，惠及实验室之外的广泛受众。

blocks.text: How academic labs are using GPT‑Rosalind
blocks.en: How academic labs are using GPT‑Rosalind
blocks.zh: 学术实验室如何使用 GPT‑Rosalind

blocks.text: OpenAI is committed to enabling academic researchers to pursue their scientific ambitions. Distinguished academic labs are already exploring how GPT‑Rosalind can support work ranging from protein design to understanding neurodegeneration. These examples show where researchers are applying the model within their scientific workflows.
blocks.en: OpenAI is committed to enabling academic researchers to pursue their scientific ambitions. Distinguished academic labs are already exploring how GPT‑Rosalind can support work ranging from protein design to understanding neurodegeneration. These examples show where researchers are applying the model within their scientific workflows.
blocks.zh: OpenAI 致力于帮助学术研究人员实现科研抱负。多家知名学术实验室已开始探索如何让 GPT‑Rosalind 支持从蛋白质设计到理解神经退行性变化等领域的研究。这些案例展示了研究人员如何将该模型应用于科研工作流。

blocks.en: “I use GPT models throughout my research, from exploring the literature to refining experiments and computational approaches. They help me iterate on ideas much faster and explore more possibilities than ever before. I feel more efficient as a researcher, with more room to explore and think creatively.”
blocks.zh: “从查阅文献到优化实验与计算方法，我在整个研究过程中都会使用 GPT 模型。它们帮助我更快地完善思路，探索比以往更多的可能性。作为研究人员，我感到自己的效率更高了，也有了更多探索和施展创意的空间。”

blocks.en: “AI systems are enabling increasingly sophisticated scientific discoveries and my lab is grateful for the Open AI compute credit grant to use GPT Rosalind, which is designed to be useful for problems in biology. My lab works on discovering and designing new biological systems from the molecular to the genome scale, and we’re looking forward to this opportunity to utilize Rosalind for our current discovery and design tasks, and to apply them at larger scales than previously possible while still providing useful insights to biological researchers.”
blocks.zh: “Rosalind 不仅能帮助我们改进现有的发现与设计工作，还能让我们以前所未有的规模开展这些工作，同时继续为生物学研究人员提供有价值的洞察。”

blocks.text: What the plan includes
blocks.en: What the plan includes
blocks.zh: 计划内容

blocks.text: With the new Rosalind Academic Plan, academic researchers can bring GPT‑Rosalind and Rosalind Workbench to their lab with greater flexibility and harness frontier model intelligence for scientific research.
blocks.en: With the new Rosalind Academic Plan, academic researchers can bring GPT‑Rosalind and Rosalind Workbench to their lab with greater flexibility and harness frontier model intelligence for scientific research.
blocks.zh: 通过全新的 Rosalind 学术计划，学术研究人员可以更灵活地将 GPT‑Rosalind 和 Rosalind 工作台引入实验室，利用前沿模型智能开展科学研究。

blocks.text: Eligible labs receive:
blocks.en: Eligible labs receive:
blocks.zh: 符合条件的实验室可获得以下支持：

blocks.text: Up to 30 Business Standard seats at $0 per user per month for up to 12 months.
blocks.en: Up to 30 Business Standard seats at $0 per user per month for up to 12 months.
blocks.zh: 最多 30 个 Business Standard 席位，每位用户每月 0 美元，使用期限最长为 12 个月。

blocks.text: Access to all commercially available frontier OpenAI models, subject to plan usage limits.
blocks.en: Access to all commercially available frontier OpenAI models, subject to plan usage limits.
blocks.zh: 可访问所有 OpenAI 商用前沿模型，但需遵守计划用量限制。

blocks.text: Access to GPT‑Rosalind following trusted-access approval.
blocks.en: Access to GPT‑Rosalind following trusted-access approval.
blocks.zh: 通过可信使用权限审批后，获得 GPT‑Rosalind 使用权限。

blocks.text: Research data shared through the Rosalind Academic Plan is not used to train our models by default.
blocks.en: Research data shared through the Rosalind Academic Plan is not used to train our models by default.
blocks.zh: 通过 Rosalind 学术计划分享的研究数据，默认不会用于训练我们的模型。

blocks.text: Build for life sciences research
blocks.en: Build for life sciences research
blocks.zh: 为生命科学研究打造

blocks.text: GPT‑Rosalind is a specialized life sciences model designed to support deeper reasoning on complex biological questions. Through trusted access, approved researchers can use it to investigate sensitive scientific questions within safeguards designed for legitimate research.
blocks.en: GPT‑Rosalind is a specialized life sciences model designed to support deeper reasoning on complex biological questions. Through trusted access, approved researchers can use it to investigate sensitive scientific questions within safeguards designed for legitimate research.
blocks.zh: GPT‑Rosalind 是一款专为生命科学打造的模型，旨在支持对复杂生物学问题进行深度推理。通过可信使用权限机制，获批的研究人员可以在为正当研究设置的安全保障下，利用该模型探究敏感的科学问题。

blocks.text: Areas of research include:
blocks.en: Areas of research include:
blocks.zh: 研究领域包括：

blocks.text: Drug and protein design
blocks.en: Drug and protein design
blocks.zh: 药物与蛋白质设计

blocks.text: Designing candidate drugs, therapeutic proteins, peptides, and enzymes, and optimizing their molecular interactions, selectivity, stability, and suitability for development.
blocks.en: Designing candidate drugs, therapeutic proteins, peptides, and enzymes, and optimizing their molecular interactions, selectivity, stability, and suitability for development.
blocks.zh: 设计候选药物、治疗性蛋白质、肽和酶，并优化其分子相互作用、选择性、稳定性和可开发性。

blocks.text: Disease detection and monitoring
blocks.en: Disease detection and monitoring
blocks.zh: 疾病检测与监测

blocks.text: Identifying molecular signatures of disease and developing liquid biopsies and other minimally invasive diagnostics to detect disease earlier, monitor progression, and assess treatment response.
blocks.en: Identifying molecular signatures of disease and developing liquid biopsies and other minimally invasive diagnostics to detect disease earlier, monitor progression, and assess treatment response.
blocks.zh: 识别疾病的分子特征，开发液体活检及其他微创诊断方法，以更早发现疾病、监测病情进展并评估治疗反应。

blocks.text: Vaccines and immune responses
blocks.en: Vaccines and immune responses
blocks.zh: 疫苗与免疫应答

blocks.text: Designing and evaluating antibodies and vaccines against emerging viral variants, investigating host–pathogen interactions, and studying the strength and durability of protective immune responses.
blocks.en: Designing and evaluating antibodies and vaccines against emerging viral variants, investigating host–pathogen interactions, and studying the strength and durability of protective immune responses.
blocks.zh: 设计和评估针对新兴病毒变异株的抗体与疫苗，探究宿主与病原体之间的相互作用，并研究保护性免疫应答的强度与持久性。

blocks.text: Genetic and RNA therapies
blocks.en: Genetic and RNA therapies
blocks.zh: 基因与 RNA 疗法

blocks.text: Developing approaches to correcting genetic defects and modulating gene expression, designing RNA therapeutics, and investigating how to deliver treatments safely and effectively to intended tissues.
blocks.en: Developing approaches to correcting genetic defects and modulating gene expression, designing RNA therapeutics, and investigating how to deliver treatments safely and effectively to intended tissues.
blocks.zh: 开发纠正遗传缺陷和调控基因表达的方法，设计 RNA 治疗药物，并研究如何将治疗药物安全、有效地递送至目标组织。

blocks.text: Agriculture and animal health
blocks.en: Agriculture and animal health
blocks.zh: 农业与动物健康

blocks.text: Investigating crop resilience, plant disease, and animal health, and applying genetic, nutritional, and biological insights to improve food production and veterinary care.
blocks.en: Investigating crop resilience, plant disease, and animal health, and applying genetic, nutritional, and biological insights to improve food production and veterinary care.
blocks.zh: 研究作物抗逆性、植物病害和动物健康，并运用遗传学、营养学和生物学知识，改善粮食生产与兽医诊疗。

blocks.text: Ecology and conservation
blocks.en: Ecology and conservation
blocks.zh: 生态与自然保护

blocks.text: Studying biodiversity, adaptation, species interactions, and environmental exposures to understand ecosystem change and inform conservation, bioremediation, and responses to climate change.
blocks.en: Studying biodiversity, adaptation, species interactions, and environmental exposures to understand ecosystem change and inform conservation, bioremediation, and responses to climate change.
blocks.zh: 研究生物多样性、适应性、物种间相互作用和环境暴露，以理解生态系统变化，为自然保护、生物修复和应对气候变化提供依据。

blocks.text: Antimicrobial resistance
blocks.en: Antimicrobial resistance
blocks.zh: 抗菌素耐药性

blocks.text: Studying how microorganisms resist antibiotics, antivirals, and antifungals, and developing new treatments for resistant infections, biofilms, and persistent disease.
blocks.en: Studying how microorganisms resist antibiotics, antivirals, and antifungals, and developing new treatments for resistant infections, biofilms, and persistent disease.
blocks.zh: 研究微生物如何抵抗抗生素、抗病毒药物和抗真菌药物，并开发针对耐药性感染、生物膜和持续性疾病的新疗法。

blocks.en: Apply on behalf of your lab

blocks.text: The Rosalind Academic Plan is currently available to academic labs at U.S. universities. PIs and lab leads at universities without an OpenAI Enterprise agreement can apply on behalf of their labs through our trusted access process. Labs at universities with an existing agreement must apply through their university’s Enterprise access process.
blocks.en: The Rosalind Academic Plan is currently available to academic labs at U.S. universities. PIs and lab leads at universities without an OpenAI Enterprise agreement can apply on behalf of their labs through our trusted access process. Labs at universities with an existing agreement must apply through their university’s Enterprise access process.
blocks.zh: Rosalind 学术计划目前面向美国各大高校的学术实验室开放。尚未签订 OpenAI Enterprise 协议的高校课题负责人和实验室负责人，可以通过我们的可信使用权限流程代表实验室提交申请。已签订协议的高校实验室，必须通过所在高校的 Enterprise 使用权限申请流程提交申请。

blocks.text: Once approved, PIs and lab leads can activate free access to GPT‑Rosalind for up to 30 named members, alongside the other OpenAI frontier models included in the plan. API access is not included at this time. Verified PIs and lab leads manage member permissions and are responsible for their lab’s approved use.
blocks.en: Once approved, PIs and lab leads can activate free access to GPT‑Rosalind for up to 30 named members, alongside the other OpenAI frontier models included in the plan. API access is not included at this time. Verified PIs and lab leads manage member permissions and are responsible for their lab’s approved use.
blocks.zh: 申请获批后，课题负责人和实验室负责人可为最多 30 名指定成员开通免费使用权限，以使用 GPT‑Rosalind 及该计划包含的其他 OpenAI 前沿模型。目前不包含 API 使用权限。通过验证的课题负责人和实验室负责人负责管理成员权限，并对实验室在获批范围内的使用行为负责。

blocks.text: Safeguards continue after activation through monitoring and enforcement. For registered high-sensitivity use cases, our safety checks account for the approved research context. When questions arise, we may follow up with researchers to clarify the work and confirm authorization. This approach is designed to detect potential misuse while accounting for legitimate research context and reducing unnecessary interruptions to authorized work.
blocks.en: Safeguards continue after activation through monitoring and enforcement. For registered high-sensitivity use cases, our safety checks account for the approved research context. When questions arise, we may follow up with researchers to clarify the work and confirm authorization. This approach is designed to detect potential misuse while accounting for legitimate research context and reducing unnecessary interruptions to authorized work.
blocks.zh: 开通权限后，我们将通过监控和规则执行持续实施安全保障。对于已登记的高敏感度用例，我们的安全检查会考虑获批的研究背景。如有疑问，我们可能会进一步联系研究人员，了解研究内容并确认授权情况。这种方式旨在发现潜在的滥用行为，同时综合考虑正当的研究背景，减少对授权研究的不必要干扰。

blocks.text: Overview of readouts
blocks.en: Overview of readouts

blocks.text: The proposed readouts include IC50/IC90 and neutralization endpoints, binding and fusion signals, and peptide integrity and retained activity in airway fluids. The proposed comparison spans surrogate and authentic-virus systems and considers aggregation, serum binding, and cell-viability signals separately. This separates antiviral potency from a direct affinity measurement, and loss of engagement from loss of intact or available compound. It also distinguishes the intended biological effect from interference with the readout itself.

blocks.text: Get started
blocks.en: Get started
blocks.zh: 入门须知

blocks.text: We’re starting with academic labs as part of a broader effort to put useful AI tools in the hands of more scientists. By lowering the cost of access, we hope to give more researchers room to pursue ideas whose benefits could reach far beyond their own labs—from a clearer understanding of disease to better treatments and more resilient food systems.
blocks.en: We’re starting with academic labs as part of a broader effort to put useful AI tools in the hands of more scientists. By lowering the cost of access, we hope to give more researchers room to pursue ideas whose benefits could reach far beyond their own labs—from a clearer understanding of disease to better treatments and more resilient food systems.
blocks.zh: 我们以学术实验室为起点，将其纳入整体计划的一部分，让更多科学家用上实用的 AI 工具。通过降低使用成本，我们希望让更多研究人员有空间去探索构想，从而在实验室之外惠及更多受众 — 其范围涵盖更清晰地认识疾病、开发更好的疗法，乃至构建更具韧性的粮食系统。

blocks.text: Those advances will come from scientists asking important questions and doing the work to answer them. We want to help more of them do that work.
blocks.en: Those advances will come from scientists asking important questions and doing the work to answer them. We want to help more of them do that work.
blocks.zh: 这些进步源自科学家提出重要问题，并开展研究、寻找答案的过程。我们希望帮助更多科学家从事此类工作。

blocks.text: If you’re affiliated with an academic lab, learn more about the Rosalind Academic Plan and check whether you’re eligible.
blocks.en: If you’re affiliated with an academic lab, learn more about the Rosalind Academic Plan and check whether you’re eligible.
blocks.zh: 如果你是学术实验室的成员，欢迎进一步了解 Rosalind 学术计划，并查看你是否符合申请条件。

keyPoints.zh: 我们已正式启动 Rosalind 学术计划，旨在帮助更多学术科研人员使用 GPT‑Rosalind — 我们专为生命科学打造的模型。该模型将前沿推理能力与 Rosalind 工作台相结合，支持在药物化学、基因组学、湿实验辅助及其他科学应用中进行专业工具编排。
keyPoints.en: We’re introducing the Rosalind Academic Plan to help more academic scientists access GPT‑Rosalind, our dedicated life sciences model, which combines frontier reasoning with Rosalind workbench that enables specialized tool orchestration across medicinal chemistry, genomics, wet-lab assistance, and other scientific applications. Eligible labs can receive up to 30 Business Standard seats at no cost for up to 12 months, with access to GPT‑Rosalind subject to trusted-access approval.

keyPoints.zh: 学术研究始终是医学和生物技术进步的基石。我们希望帮助更多科学家将专业知识和判断力与 GPT‑Rosalind 先进的专业推理能力相结合，助其取得突破性发现，惠及实验室之外的广泛受众。
keyPoints.en: Academic research has always laid the groundwork for advances in medicine and biotechnology. By helping more scientists combine their scientific expertise and judgment with the advanced specialized reasoning of GPT‑Rosalind, we hope to support discoveries whose benefits reach far beyond the lab.

keyPoints.zh: 通过全新的 Rosalind 学术计划，学术研究人员可以更灵活地将 GPT‑Rosalind 和 Rosalind 工作台引入实验室，利用前沿模型智能开展科学研究。
keyPoints.en: With the new Rosalind Academic Plan, academic researchers can bring GPT‑Rosalind and Rosalind Workbench to their lab with greater flexibility and harness frontier model intelligence for scientific research.

keyPoints.zh: 通过 Rosalind 学术计划分享的研究数据，默认不会用于训练我们的模型。
keyPoints.en: Research data shared through the Rosalind Academic Plan is not used to train our models by default.
